question: Who wrote the book ‘If God Was A Banker’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravi Subramanian**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ravi Subramanian**

 
 
• Ravi Subramanian, an Indian author, wrote 'If God Was A Banker'.
 
• The book was** first published in 2007** and **focuses on the banking industry**.
 
• It explores the ethical dilemmas in the corporate world through its characters.
 
• 'If God Was A Banker' has **won the Golden Quill Readers Choice Award**.
 
• Ravi Subramanian is known for his thrilling novels, often set against the backdrop of the financial services industry.
